payload.body_they: Questioning the established way can become part of what {{Name}} is known for, especially when they can show that another approach works better. They may challenge the accepted method in school, creative work, an organization, a public role, or a profession. Being different is useful when the difference improves something. What they become known for should reflect their independence without making novelty itself the entire point.
